tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don

snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro mgon rin po che/ /gnas lugs don ston chos rje rin po che/ /bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad dpa' bos byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir gcod zab mo nyams su len pa'i gang zag gis/ /nam 'chi cha med dran pas tshe 'di blo yis thong*/ /chos min bsam rgyu med cing snying rus zhe bcad che/ /bla mas ci gsung sgrub cing gnyan khrod ri la tshugs/ /rkyen ngan klod la bsre zhing gang byung ro snyoms pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos pa lags/ de nas nyams su blang pa'i chos ni 'di yin te/ brgyud pa la mos gus tshugs/ byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur thob nas/ 'khrid kyi ngo bo la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mdun du yi dam dang sangs rgyas/ g.yas su dam chos kyi ngo bo glegs bam/ g.yon du theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams gsal btab la/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi skyid sdug legs nyes khyed rang shes bsam pas/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems thams cad sangs rgyas gtso la skyabs su mchi/ dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi/ kun 'dus bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi/ rang sems stong pa chos sku gsum la skyabs su mchi/ zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /mthar skyabs yul rnams rang la thim/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dung ba'i ngang nas/ ma rgan sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu mtha' dag dang ldan par bya'o/

/sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mtha' dag dang bral bar bya'o/ /myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub re thob par bya'o/ /zhes ngag nas brjod cing yid la bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gi mdun du bla ma dang ma cig lab sgron dbyer med pa/ mdun du yi dam sogs skyabs yul bzhin gsal btab/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mchod rdzas 'dod yon longs spyod thams cad kyis phyur bur bkang ste/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs dang bcas pa bla ma dkon mchog la phul bar mos la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'am gang yang rung ba 'bul zhing*/ mgo zhabs su maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa re yang 'bul zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal re re'i mthar bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba kun/ /bla ma dkon mchog khyed la 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa lan re re brjod/ bzhi pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa bsgom la/ snying thag pa nas mos gus drag po bskyed cing*/ 'di nyid kyi brgyud 'debs kyang spro na bya/ khyad par bdag sogs sems can thams cad bla ma la mos 'dun drag po'i gsol ba 'debs par bsam nas/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin po che/ / bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /re sa gzhan na med pas da lta byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skye med gcig chod du rtogs pa byin gyi rlobs/ /bar chad dngos grub tu longs par byin gyi rlobs/ /bdud tshogs rang sar chod par byin gyi rlobs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ thun gyi mjug tu/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bla mas rjes su 'dzin par smon lam btab ste cung zad ngal bso/ /re zhig de dag re re la dmigs pa 'byongs 'byongs su bsgom nas/ slar yang snga dro skyabs 'gro/ nyin gung sems bskyed/

dgong mo maṇ+ḍal/ srod la bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams drag tu bsgom pa zhag bdun nam/ zla ba phyed la sogs pa bskyangs pas/ de dag la myong ba ci rigs pa thon yong zhing*/ dngos gzhi dang mthun pa'i nyams rtogs kyang than thun skye ba srid/ gang ltar na'ang sngar so sor bsgom pa rnams la yang zhag bdun re tsam bya zhing kun dril bas sngon 'gro la ma mtha' yang*/ zla ba phyed gnyis tsam re byed pa gal che/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ yum don ngo sprod pa dang*/ bdud bzhi dbyings su gcod pa'o/ /dang po la sems 'dzin gyi gdams ngag dang*/ ngo sprod gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas/ ngag rlung rang sor bzhag/ sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i spros pa bcad nas/ sngar gyi rnam rtog 'gags/ phyi ma skyes pa/ da ltar ba'i shes pa skad cig ma 'di la so ma khad de bzhag rnam rtog thol thol skyen rbad rbad 'phro bcad la sngar lugs bzhin bskyangs/ 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams su 'gro na skyon che bas phyin chad 'di lta bu ma byung ba byed dgos snyam pa dang*/ zhe bcad chen po byas la/ yang dran pas bzung ste sngar bzhin bsgoms pas de je nyung du 'gro /re zhig de kha ma gtogs thabs gzhan mi bya/ yun ring du bsgoms kyang rnam rtog drag tu 'khrug pa kho na byung na/ rang gi mdun du gser gyi rdo rje nas 'bru tsam zhig gsal btab la zan kham gsum za yun tsam zhig de la rig pa drag tu gtad cing gzir/ de 'phral la sngar bzhin ma bcos so ma bskyang/ yang rdo rje la sems gtad/ yang so ma'i ngang bskyangs/ yang rdo rje la sems gtad/ tshul de lta bu bzhur la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bsgom/ nyin re re bzhin de ltar byas pas rnam rtog shugs chad de sal ting gis 'gro/ gal te des ma phan na rdo rje'i tshabs su bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i sku che chung tshon gang tsam zhig bsgom/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ des kyang ma phan na bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa zhal nas phaṭa kyi sgra drag po lhang lhang sgrogs pa/

sku lus gnam lcags 'bar ba bzhin gang la'ang thog med du 'gro ba tshon gang ba tsam zhig gang nas byung cha med pa byon te/ rang gi lus 'di la yar thal mar thal phar thal tshur thal du phug pa la sems drag tu gtad/ de 'phral mi rtog pa'i ngang bskyangs pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom pas rnam rtog gya ma gyu dang gzhan yang ting 'dzin skye ba la bar chad thams cad nges par sel ba yin/ de ltar thabs de rnams dang bcas pas sngar bzhin mnyam par bzhag pa na sems gsal hrig ge ba dang bcas song ba ci 'dod byas par 'byung zhing*/ bsam mno sogs dgos pa rnams kyang dran thub cing*/ mi 'dod bzhin du rnam rtog 'dre ba ma yin pas/ zhi gnas kyang klung du phebs par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'di dag tu shes pa mi gsal zhing mun mun pa dang*/ thun mtshams su rmongs shing dran pa mi gsal na/ bying ba bsang pa'i nus pa yin pas khang stengs sam/ ri rtse'i gzhan yang bsil zhing thongs dkar sar phyin/ mig gyen la gtad/ rig pa hur phyungs te bsgom na nges par sel ba yin/ gnyis pa ngo sprod pa ni/ sngar gyi de kha'i ngang las kha nang log gi shes pas sems kho rang gi ngo bo la cher re bltas/ phyi snang ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa la ma yengs tsam du bzhag pas/ ci yang ma yin zhing*/ ngos bzung rgyu med pa de kha yang yang bsgom/ de la rang gi nyams myong skye tshul dang bstun nas bla mas ngo sprod dgos pa yin/ 'on kyang ngo sprod pa'i don nyams su len tshul ni/ sems 'di nyid gnas pa'i dus na ngos bzung gcig kyang med cing rang snang gsal gsal ba zhes kyang 'char 'char du btub pa/ 'gyu ba'i dus na 'gyu ba nyid ngo bo yul yul ba'i 'gyu stongs 'gyu ba'i snang ba ma 'gags kyang ngos bzung gcig kyang med/ yul gyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba'ang*/ snang ba 'gags med lam lam 'char bzhin pa'i dus nas ngos bzung du med pa de lta yul snang dang*/ rnam rtog dang sems gnas pa'i ngo bo gsum tha dad du ma grub ste dbye ba med/

gcig tu yang ma grub ste/ thams cad yul stong*/ de kha yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i don yin/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/ stong pa nyid dang*/ spros bral dang*/ brjod bral dang*/ don dam la sogs pa'i tha snyad ji snyed pa zhig btag mod/ don rang sems skad cig ma gcig bu de yin pas de ka la rang ngo shes tsam gyis sgo nas/ gnas sam 'gyu ba gang byung de la bzo bcos med par mnyam par 'jog /gnyis pa bdud bzhi dbyings su bcad pa la bzhi las/ dang po thog bcas kyi bdud dbyings su bcad pa ni/ dgra gnyen sogs chags sdang gi yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la brten nas/ rnam rtog 'dzin pa dang bcas pa skyes ched thog bcad bcas kyi bdud ces bya ba yin/ thog bcas kyi go don gzugs sogs phyi'i dngos po la brten pa'i don yin/ de gcod par byed pa ni/ dper na dgra lta bu zhig dran te zhe sdang gi rnam rtog tshig pa za ba rim gyis byung ba na/ de'i dbang du ma shor ba skad cig de nyid la phaṭa ces drag tu brjod/ rnam rtog de la skyon yon gang du yang mi blta bar 'phro rbad kyis bcad nas sngar gyi yum don gyi dbyings der cha mer bzhag /de bzhin du gnyen dang nor rdzas sogs la chags sems dang*/ gzugs sogs yid du 'ong ba la chags/ mi 'ong ba la sdang zhing skyug log /'ga' zhig la 'jigs/ 'ga' zhig la skyo/ bar ma rnams la yang chags sdang sogs kyi mtho dman med kyang*/ der 'dzin gyi rnam rtog skye tshad thams cad la sngar bzhin sbyangs/ de yang rnam rtog lam gyis byung ba lhongs/ de'i dbang du shor na bdud kyi khyer/ de nyid du phaṭa brjod nas 'phro gcod pa ni gcod/ de rjes su sngar gyi bsgom la bogs thon pa ni tshar tshad chod tshad yin/ 'di 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa thog med kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ thog med kyi bdud kyi go don/

phyi rol gyi rkyen la ma rag par rkyen med kyang dga' ba'am/ mi dga' ba'am/ spro snang ngam/ skyo ba'am/ 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i mtho dman gyi rnam rtog skye ba rnams yin te/ de yang lam gyis shar ba na phaṭa kyis 'phro bcad la dbyings su bzhag go /gsum pa dga' brod kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ bla ma dang chos brgyud bzang ba dang*/ rang la dge sbyor 'phel ba'am/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa sogs kyi bzang 'dzin dang*/ nga rgyal la brten nas dga' brod skyid snang skyes na dga' brod kyi bdud yin te/ gong bzhin dbyings su gcod do/ /bzhi pa snyems byed kyi bdud gcod pa ni/ rnam rtog dang 'dzin pa ci byung thams cad snyems byed kyi bdud yin/ gang shar thams cad gong bzhin phaṭa kyis dbyings su bskyal bas chod par 'gyur ro/ /'di la gong ma gsum char 'dus/ 'di yan chad la rang stobs kyi nyams len rkang tshugs pa'i myong pa med par gnyan khrod 'grims pa stong zob yin/ sgom gyi rkang 'di yan chad la tshugs dgos/ gnyan khrod byed pa bogs 'don dag 'gro ba'i don yin pas de bzhin go dgos so/ /gsum pa rjes nyams skyong ba la don gsum ste/ zhi gcod/ drag gcod/ zhi drag phyed ma'i gcod do/ /de la dang po ni/ rang gi gnas khang du sems can thams cad la byams snying rje thun bzhir drag tu bsgom zhing*/ thun bzhi kar dkar 'byed tshar re byed pa gal che/ de yang rang gi mdun du mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum byung*/ rang sems rdo rje'i phag mo'i rnam pas smin mtshams nas phyir thon/ thod pa breg ste sgyaid pu'i steng du bkal/ rang lus lhag ma rnams dum bur gtubs te der blug rgya khyon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor song*/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' mo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs/

de thams cad la mchod pas de rnams tshims shing dgyes/ 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad la sbyin pas gnas skabs su tshim zhing mthar thug sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ bdud rtsi'i lhag ma gtor bas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par byung nas/ mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod par bsam/ de thams cad rang sems su shes/ de'i ngo bo la cher gyis bltas la phaṭa ces brjod la dbyings rig bsre/ yang de rnams lam te dran par byas la/ slar yang phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre/ de lta bu lan mang du bya'o/ /de ltar bsgom la dmigs pa cung zad 'byongs pa na/ rang nyid gnyan khrod gang du 'gro ba der 'dun pa btang la/ spyir sems can thams cad dang bye brag tu gnyan khrod de'i gzhi bdag dang 'byung po 'dre gdon sogs thams cad la byams snying rje drag tu bsgom zhing*/ sngar gyi dkar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa de kha yang yang bsgom pa gnyis zhag gnyis gsum byas la/ lam du 'gro tshe yang byams snying rje dang dbyings rig bsre ba spel ma de ka bsgom/ gnas der sleb nas sa gnad che ba zhig btsal la bsdad/ der thog mar gzhi bdag dang 'byung po sogs la sil gtor dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor/ bgegs gtor sogs shes tshad gtang*/ de dag tu yang byams snying rje drag tu bsgom pa gal che/ de nas skyabs 'gro sogs sngon 'gro rnam bzhi drag la 'jur ba yun ring ba bya/ de'i rjes su sngar bzhin dkar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa de lan mang du bsgom/ slar yang spyir 'gro drug gi sems can/ dgos gnyan khrod 'di'i 'dre gdon la gtso bor dmigs nas byams snying rje drag tu bsgom/ yul phyogs de dang 'dre gdon sogs sems can du snang ba lam lam pa de'i steng du shes pa cher gyis gtad la phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsres la 'dzin med du bzhag /yang snying rje bsgom/ yang dbyings rig bsre ba sogs de kho na bsgom/

ltas dang cho 'phrul ci byung na yang dbyings rig bsre ba dang snying rje bsgom pa gnyis po rang la bsgrim/ cho 'phrul drag po byung yang rung*/ ma byung yang rung*/ mthar gnas bag chags shing dge sbyor 'phel ba'i tshe/ tshar tshad chod tshad 'grigs pa yin pas/ dge sbyor bogs thon pa'i btang rag tu dmigs pa'i sgo nas dkar 'gyed lan mang du btang zhing*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro la gtor bsngo dang gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma rgya cher byin/ smon lam ci shes 'don/ lam du yang sngar bzhin bsgom la/ rang gnas su sleb pa na dkon mchog la gtang rag gi mchod gtor ci shes 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar rang gi gnas khang du thun gyi nyams len zhi gcod dang 'dra ba las/ thun gyi mthar dmar 'gyed gyi dmigs pa re bya/ de la dmar 'gyed ni/ rang sems sngar bzhin phyir bton la/ rang lus de stong gsum khyab pa'i mi ro tsho bcud snum bag dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha srin sde brgyad thams cad la 'bod pa'i skad btang bas/ thams cad skad cig la 'dus te sa dang nam mkha' thams cad khyab par bsam/ de nas rang lus dum bu dum bur gtub/ khyed cag ci 'dod zo/ gang 'dod longs/ zhes brjod pas so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ sha khrag rus pa nang khrol yan lag sogs zos 'thung khyer bas/ gnas skabs tshim zhing*/ mthar thug nyon mongs zhi bar bsam/ slar de dag thams cad rang gnas su song bar bsgom/ de nas de yang rang sems su shes bzhin pas phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre la bzhag /de lta bu yang yang bsgom/ de la cung zad goms nas gnyan khrod zhig la dmigs te slar yang zhag gnyis gsum bsgom/ lam du bsgom tshul zhi gcod dang 'dra/ gnas der sleb nas sa gnad gnyan sa zhig btsal nas bsdad/ sngon 'gro'i chos bzhi po spy-ir sngar dang 'dra ba las rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa sgom pa dang*/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs bla ma dang ma cig dbyer med pa rang la thim pas/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar gyur/ de nyid ye shes kyi me drag tu 'bar ba dang bcas te/ drag po'i steng stabs sna tshogs kyi gar mdzad/ gsung skad drag sngags sna tshogs 'brug ltar sgrogs par bsam la/ 'di'i skabs ma cig gi nga rgyal dang bcas pa ni dgos shing*/ 'dre gdon rnams la gnod sems gtan nas med par sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes bzhin du gang snang gi ngo bo la rang sems ched cher bsre bzhin du phaṭa ces dbyings rig bsre ba kho na bya/ 'tshub dang cho 'phrul ldang na phaṭa dang bcas par mchong rgyug dang*/ drag sngags shes tshad 'don/ de nas yang sngar gyi shul du 'dug ste/ stong pa nyid kho na la mnyam par bzhag /sems kyi mtho dman dang*/ 'char sgo rnam rtog cis byung kyang phaṭa ces dbyings rigs bsre ba kho na bya/ 'tshub dang cho 'phrul lhongs kyi phyi mthong snang dang*/ nang na tsha/ gsang ba nyon mongs log lta sogs ci skyes kyang 'khrul par shes pas dbyings rigs bsre ba kho na las gzhan gang yang mi byed cing yum don kho na la mnyam par bzhag /ngag gi smra brjod dang*/ lus kyis 'gul bskyod sogs gtan nas mi byed pa'i dam 'cha' dang zhe mna' lag tu longs pa bya/ rnam pa thams cad du lus sems la gces 'dzin rdul tsam med par bya/ lha 'dre drag pos dngos su sdod pa spo dgos byung na sngar gyi shul der sdod pa bya/ dngos su gang du bzhag byung ba der sdod/ dngos gzhi rang gi skabs 'dir gzhan la skyabs zhu bar ma song ba/ bsrung 'khor du ma song ba/ 'dre 'dul du ma song ba/ re dogs su ma song ba gal che chung ci byung rung khyad par med pa'i blo btad dang*/ dbyings rigs bsre ba'i mi rtog pa dang ma bral ba gal che/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi tshad lhongs 'grigs pa na/ dmar 'gyed kyi dmigs pa yang 'ga' re bya zhing*/

rjes kyi bya ba zhi gcod dang 'dra ba las/ chab gtor klu gtor sogs gtor ma ci mang gtong ba dang*/ smon lam mang du 'debs pa/ chos bshad mdo 'don pa sogs la brtson pa gal che/ de ltar byas pas khos gnas lus longs spyod nyams pa gsos/ sngar las kyang lhag par song bsam pa dang*/ chos dang ldan par song snyam pa yang yang bsam/ rjes kyi bya ba yang sngar dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma dang 'dra ba las dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed gnyis ka bsgom/ gnyan khrod du sleb ma thag tu zhi gcod ltar gtor ma rgya cher btang*/ sngon 'gro chos bzhi snga thun gnyis la zhi gcod lta bu dang*/ phyi thun gnyis la drag gcod ltar bsgoms/ dngos gzhi nyams len yang zhi gcod kyi dmigs pa lan mang du 'gro ba'i mthar drag gcod ltar stong nyid kho na bsgom pa thun re bzhin bya/ yun ring por lhongs ma byung na drag gcod kyi skabs ltar lhongs klongs pa'i spros bcas kyi gcod tshul de lan re byas pas nges par lhongs yong bar gdon mi za/ re zhig de ma zhi bar la drag gcod bzhin du stong nyid kho na bsgoms/ lha 'dre dngos su rgol du byung na/ snying dmar tsar gyis bton nas ster ba'am/ mgo dang rkang lag rbad kyis bcad nas ster ba sogs lus sems ma bral bzhin du lus la gces 'dzin rdul tsam med par phung po gzan du bskyur ba 'di gal che/ tshar lhongs 'grigs pa na rjes kyi bya ba gong dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag la nye bar mkho ba'i skabs don cung zad cig brjod na/ thog mar gnyan khrod bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan can/ gzhi bdag 'jam zhing chos la dkar ba zhig tu zhi gcod nyams su len du 'gro/ thog ma nas drag gcod byed pa dang*/ gnas rtsub pa dang*/ nag phyogs kyi 'dre gdon gnas pa'i sar 'gro ba lam du long dka' zhing*/ de nyid lam du song yang chos brgyud dang mched grogs sogs gang cir rten 'brel mi legs pa yin/ de nas thog mar zhi gcod la brten nas gnyan khrod bkra shis pa lan gnyis gsum tsam 'grim pa'i rjes su gnyan khrod 'bring po 'ga' rer zhi drag bsgoms/

de nas gnyan khrod rtsub pa 'ga' rer zhi gcod bsgom/ de ltar gnyan khrod mang du bsgom zhing 'byongs ba na/ gnyan khrod rtsub pa 'ga' rer zhi drag phyed ma ci rigs pa bya/ 'dre gdon gdug pa can gnas sar drag gcod 'ba' zhig kyang skabs rer byed pa yin/ spyir rgyun gyi nyams len zhi drag phyed ma yin/ lha 'dre 'jam zhing chos la dkar ba'i sar gtso bor zhi gcod rang bya zhing*/ zhi drag phyed ma'ang skabs dang bstun nas byar rung*/ drag gcod 'ba' zhig bya mi nyan/ zh-i drag phyed ma'i skabs 'dir gong du bstan pa de la/ spros bcas zer zhing*/ de'i mjug tu zhi gcod ltar byams snying rje dang dbyings rig bsre ba spel ma bsgom pa la spros med zer/ de'i rjes su yum don kho na la mnyam par 'jog pa la shin tu spros med kyi gcod zer ba yin pas/ de dag kyang 'brel chags su bsgoms par bya'o/ /gcod las la 'gro khar nyon mongs chags sdang gi sems drag po skyes pa dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus la ldem 'gyangs shor ba dang*/ mched grogs dang gcod pa dam sel zhugs pa dang*/ thig le nyams pa sogs byung na rten 'brel 'chug nas gnyan khrod 'grim pa gnad du mi 'gro/ des na gsol 'debs/ snying rje/ bshags pa/ smon lam/ tshogs mchod/ gtor ma/ rtsa rlung sgom pa sogs rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs nas 'gro ba gal che/ lhongs la gsum las/ phyi'i lhongs ni sa g.yo ba dang*/ ri nyur ba dang*/ 'jigs pa'i mthong snang dang*/ thos snang 'di mi 'byung ba med pa 'ongs/ nang gi lhongs/ snying rlung*/ klad gzer/ rgyu ma gzer ba sogs na tsha drag po glo bur du 'byung*/ gsang lhongs sems la byung ste/ dga' snang dang*/ sdug snang mi tshugs pa lta bu dang*/ 'jigs skrag dang*/ skyo ngas dang*/ 'dod yon gyi rnam rtog dang*/ chos brgyad kyi 'char sgo la sogs pa dang*/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog cher 'phel ba sogs 'byung zhing*/

chos dang bla ma la log lta ldang*/ de 'dra'i rigs thams cad lhongs su shes par bya'o/ /lus mi bskyod/ kha don gyi rim pa dang*/ phaṭa sngags brjod pa ma gtogs tha mal gyi ngag mi smra ba la zung thub pa dang*/ sems 'char sgo ci byung thams cad de'i dbang du mi gtong ba dbyings rigs bsre ba rang gal che ba'o/ /yang skye bo mang po 'du sar sdod dgos sam 'grims dgos byung ba'i tshe/ mi sngon du dge sbyor byed pa de spyir yang dgag bya che zhing*/ khyad par phaṭa sngags drag po brjod pa sogs mi mdzes pas/ phaṭa ces shub shub po brjod cing*/ nyams len gyi gdengs gtan nas ma shor ba gnad du shes che/ yang sa cha yul mi 'dre gdon sogs mthong ba'i yul dang sems snang du lam de 'char bar byas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la snying rje dung ba zhig bsgom la/ 'di thams cad dbang du bsdu snyam pa'i 'dun pa zhig btang*/ de nas phaṭa ces brjod pas thams cad dbyings su bskyal/ 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa tho rangs la sogs par lan ci mang bstud nas bsgom/ de'i mthar smon lam rgya cher btab/ gang la yang ma zhen par sgyu ma lta bur sgom nas sa phyogs de dag gi mi dang mi ma yin thams cad dbang du 'du nges so/ /des mtshon de 'phrin las rnam bzhi gang bsgrub kyang dmigs pa'i gnad 'di rigs 'grai bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang mos gus gsol 'debs dbyings su bskyal bas/ bla mas thugs rjes 'dzin zhing byin rlabs 'jug /snying rje dbyings su bskyal bas 'gro don 'byung zhing sems can dbang du 'du/ skyo shas nges 'byung dbyings su bskyal bas rang gi dge sbyor gnad du 'gro zhing gzhan rgyud chos la 'khul ched/ bskyed rim dbyings su bskyal bas nus pa che zhing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong dbang du 'du/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor dbyings su bskyal bas rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro 'du ba rgyun mi 'chad/

gnyan khrod 'grims shing gnad du song na sde brgyad dregs pa can thams cad bran 'khol thub/ gzhan yang 'dod chags dbyings su bskyal bas 'dod chags can gyi 'gro ba 'dul nus 'khor 'du/ 'on kyang de snying rjes ma zin na rang dang nye 'khor sogs la de la brten nas bar chad 'byung bas/ 'dod chags dbyings su bskyal ba'i stong nyid dang snying rjer skyes ba gal che/ des mtshon te nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre/ de thams cad kyang rtsa ba re dogs med pa gal che bas/ spyir gcod kyis bar chad thams cad sel zhing dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin na'ang*/ dngos grub thob la re ba dang phan yon 'byung la re ba zhe 'dod pa gtan med pa gcig dgos/ blo yi gting skyon ma thon na dge sbyor gnad du mi 'gro ste/ bla ma log lta can dang*/ chos la tshod yod po dang*/ rang bzang 'dod ngan mi 'dod pa dang*/ nor rdzas longs spyod la shi bar 'thams pa dang*/ re dogs kyis khyer nas blo thag gcad mi nus pa rnams la/ gnyan khrod lam du longs ba'i sgom skye ba ga la srid/ lha 'dre gdug pa can gyi lhongs zhi ba skad/ longs spyod snyan grags than thun grub pa skad/ mgo bskor gtong ba mang bas/ gnyan khrod la dge sbyor gyi blo skyed chen po ma byung bar tshar tshad brdzus ma sad sud de la yid brtan ma byed cig /dge sbyor gyi bogs thon byung na gzhan de tsho byung ma byung 'dra/ 'dun ma legs pa'i yang rtse yin no/ /gcod yul kun gyi snying po'i don/ /dgongs 'du'i sgrub thabs 'di yin pas/ /nyams len gyis shig skal ldan bu/ /tsab tsob blo sna ma mang zhig/ //gcod yul zab mo'i khrid yig gnad don snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni bya bral ba rin chen bkra shis zhes bya bas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa ste/ stag lung thang gi chos grwar sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o/ /
